reviews.text: Probably the best vet I've been to for my cat! They were attentive and listened to my concerns. Provided plenty of options and routes for treatment, making sure I understood the different options and only doing what I was comfortable with. I never felt pressured and my cat was being well taken care of through the whole visit.

I've been bringing my boys here for the last 6 years and have no complaints. This office and the staff have been great over the years, they take good care of my kitties, and they have some adorable little office assistants as well.
I I wanted to express my deepest gratitude to everyone here for taking such good care of my cat fluffy. We will definitely be back.
You people are absolutely awesome!  Thanks for taking care of Reeko!

Dr Shrerama and her assistant were very caring and gentle. My cat Symba was worried, as she is at any doctor appointment, yet calm. The environment gives off a welcoming energy. Upon entry, Casper greeted Symba to let her know it is a genuine place to relax.

I can’t write a review because I have no way to say The Best Veterinary service and care for our pets. I have been to this hospital since 2005. If you want the best care in Philadelphia for your pets please pick The Cat Doctor. I was just there yesterday and my girl is much better off. Love to all the people who work there!

I believe we have finally found our ideal vet resource in Philly!  Our normally ravenous and overweight feline, Elsa, wasn't eating properly.  Normally, Elsa is a terror among vets and even earned the title 'Jailbreaker' by escaping her cage at PennVet.  But Dr. Jones seemed quite calm about confronting Elsa's inner beast and I believe that Elsa picked up on the vibe by providing a peaceful experience, wrapped in a blanket.  Maybe the overall home-like ambiance of the establishment had something to do with it also.

But handling wasn't the only plus.  It was refreshing to have the exam performed in front of us instead of in a back room.  I believe there is value in that.  The diagnosis seemed very reasonable and it was communicated clearly, allowing options if we wanted to pursue them but not advocating additional diagnostic services (e.g. x-rays, sonagrams, whatever).  Even the fee was very inexpensive.  Hard to find anything not to like about the visit and we intend to rely of The Cat Doctor for our ongoing veterinary care.

The practice is certified by two excellent rating organizations and you can see the other ratings on Google.  What's not to like?  Thanks Dr. Jones and thanks Cat Doctor!

It has taken me some time to write this review after the loss of my beloved cat, Lili on December 6th last year.
I am deeply grateful to Dr. Beiting and the entire veterinary team for the care, patience, and professionalism they showed Lili throughout her illness. Lili was very sassy and spicy and never enjoyed vet visits, but they always treated her with kindness and understanding.
When it came time to say goodbye, Dr. Goin was incredibly compassionate during Lili’s euthanasia and made one of the hardest moments a little more peaceful.
The veterinary assistant that day was wonderful and even remembered Lili from a previous visit, calling her “spicy Lili,” which made me smile in the middle of my grief. The front desk lady on Sat 12/6/25 was also very kind and supportive during such a difficult day.
I will always be thankful for the dignity, warmth, and care they gave Lili until the very end. Also thank you for the card. It meant a lot to me.
I’ve been taking my two cats here for years and they’ve always been very well taken care of. All of the staff is incredibly friendly and the office cats are super sweet!

I received a call from their “scheduling service” yesterday evening to schedule an appointment, which I scheduled for this morning. I showed up for the appointment this morning. The receptionists said they did not have me on the schedule, and that their “scheduling service” only “requests” appointments, which have to confirmed by their office. Then why did no one call me this morning to tell me it was not confirmed? I took time out of my day to pack up my cat and drive over here, and the receptionists just said “Yea we’ve brought this up to management.” Not even an attempt to squeeze me in! Sorry Cat Doctor, you need better management.

The Vets at The Cat Doctor are the best. She took so much time with our cats and I feel like they got a great exam. She was great at explaining things to us. I think everyone should take their cats to the Cat Doctor. Dr. Martin was so gentle and the Vet Tech was so caring and soothing. What a great experience for us and our cats.

My cats are not a fan of the vet, but they do so well here. Everyone from check-in to check-out is thorough and kind. I appreciate the extra attention and patience they give my furry children, especially with my senior kitty. Highly recommend.

Awful unprofessional practice. Had important appointment for my cat who needed medical care. They tried to call me the morning a few hours before my appointment to tell me I had to take him to urgent care, when I pressed them on it, the real reason was that they had a scheduling conflict and couldn’t uphold their appointment. They lied, gave me a run around about paperwork and my cat is still not seen. Skip. These people do not care about you or your animal
Thank you!
I've been going to Cat Doctor for many years. Everyone there is very knowledgeable, kind, and great with cats and their people.  I wouldn't go anywhere else.
My cat has been coming for a few years. I love it. Him not so much. Staff is caring and the atmosphere is peaceful and quiet. The wait is not long for appointments and the service is fast.
Absolutely incredible staff and service. I brought my two babies here for the first time and they could not have been more attentive or caring.
I bring both of my cats here and love it so much! Everyone that works here is friendly and knowledgeable and they make scheduling so easy.
This place is definitely made for cats.  warm and comfortable environment so much unlike other vet offices. A kind vet that wants what's best for your animal.

Just moved to the neighborhood and decided to try this vet when my cat got sick after moving into my new apartment. I suspected stress-induced pancreatitis. Spent $600 for bloodwork and received no answers and no help. I was told the next step would be to pay $1000 for an ultrasound. They wouldn’t even give her fluids to help with dehydration unless I hospitalized her. Also, when I called to ask for help as my cat was still having diarrhea all over my apartment, I was greeted by an annoyed receptionist and told I would probably not get a call back because they were short staffed. They pretend to care about their clients to get their money!!!!!!! GO ELSEWHERE IF YOUR CAT IS SICK!!!!!!!!!!
Knowledgeable cat-focused practice. Amazing bedside manner and attentive to the pet's needs. Overall just wonderful.

My feline daughter and I just moved to the area. She is 16 and I wanted to make sure we established with a new vet and to make sure she is doing well after the move. The Cat Doctor practice is wonderful! Very soothing atmosphere and everyone is so friendly and helpful. Dr Jones was so great with my little girl. I can’t say enough how happy I am that we found the Cat Doctor. I’d recommend to everyone!
This clinic did an excellent job taking care of our new kitty! Very sweet and attentive, would definitely come back in the future :)

Had a great experience today with Dr. Jones and her tech! I brought my two cats in for a full wellness exam and left with a clear game plan on what needs to be done moving forward to ensure my cats are happy and healthy. Dr. Jones was so patient and answered all of my questions in great detail. You can tell
She’s very passionate about what she does and it shows! Looking forward to future appointments, I know my cats are in good hands!
They truly care about their patients, they always make the time to properly communicate and do their best to treat my kitty! I am so grateful I found this place!
wonderful place with very caring staff
I couldn’t be happier with how they treated my little Sadie. The examined her and came up with a treatment plan. I will be coming back.

First time going here - they were amazing with my cat! Let me know the costs up front and let me make a decision about it, no pressure. My fur baby got all the love and care and was in good hands. Thank you!
They really take care and patience with your cats..
I am so happy to have switched my vet care. I took my sick Ottoboy today. I couldn’t be happier with the comprehensive care he received. The house cats are absolutely adorable.

Can’t go wrong with The Cat Doctor. They make everything easy—scheduling, prescriptions, payment. Additionally, there is never any wait time, and it is always calm in the waiting room. The doctors and nurses are wonderful, kind, and experienced. I couldn’t recommend a place more.

Dr. Beiting is a wonderful vet.  If she were at a different practice I would definitely return to her.  However, The Cat Dr. only has appointments a week or more in advance.  If my cat is sick, or dying (like my 18 year old blind Siamese was), they could not fit him in.  I had to take him to an emergency vet where he had never been before with people he didn't know so he could be peacefully put down.  My cat had kidney disease and had taken a turn for the worse and stopped eating.  I called several times to try to get an appointment so he could be put down in a place he knew with people he knew.  I could only get an appointment a full week away.  What good is a vet's office that only sees healthy animals??  I will be taking my other 2 cats elsewhere.
The service is impecable and caring.Shout out  to the Cat Whisperer.

The vet was personable and informed - the graceless veterinary aide however, grunted a salutation, made no effort at being pleasant and handled my cat authoritatively to the point of seeming aggressive. For that reason I will go elsewhere in the future.

Lovely place with friendly staff! My nervous boy was comfy with me on the waiting room couches. He was at ease during the whole process, including shots. I paid a good price and were on our way back home, with medicine, within the hour. I'll definitely bring him here from now on!
I have only had positive experiences with this vet! They are transparent and kind and knowledgeable. Happily recommend!

Took our two boys here for the first time as new patients, they took us in same week of us calling. Few other places wouldn't accept us for a few months which was not going to happen and wanted hefty deposits????
But this place has great and the staff truly love cats. One of our boys has been having respiratory problems and the vets have been very helpful.

from the desk to the doctors, i love this place! they take such great care of my cat, and super responsive. so kind overall. the place is extremely clean and i love how they have one or two cats sleeping on the couch in the waiting area; adorable and makes my cat feel at ease. only docking a point because of the location, since parking can be a pain. but otherwise, i absolutely recommend 10/10
Good care & great bedside manner. Plus the cats who live at the office are charming

I'm a new customer with a highly reactive cat.....

The waiting room is welcoming and cozy. …
I have been going here for years and always have had good and caring service. They are attentive and patient with my skittish cat. They are responsive and informative as well.

Brought my little cat here today for the first time. It’s a really great office. Front staff is friendly, it’s easy to get an appointment, short wait times once you get there. The doctor and vet tech (nurse, I’m not sure?) were so kind and …

A wonderful experience for the kitties and their humans both.  I love that there are cats living there and the Dr and staff are great!  Very compassionate and informed.  Thoroughly answered all our questions and referred us to a place that could do dental for less $.  Can't boast about The Cat Doctor enough!  🐱 …

The cat doctor has a manager Maami who is unprofessional loud and a screaming Mimi
She is very loud and has a disturbing tone about her …
